_about: Canonical ATT&CK<->OCSF join for the C5 ocsf-attack-coverage bench. One entry per ATT&CK id. Two joins are kept DELIBERATELY SEPARATE: (1) the technique<->OCSF-class binding (ocsf_class_uid + store_f_table) is MEASURED -- it comes from the ocsf-sigma-detection run.py RULES dict and the console detections.py pairing, and it is what the runner actually fires a Sigma rule against; (2) the technique<->D3FEND join (d3fend_join='matrix_long') is INFERRED -- it marks that the scg gap-hop sources its defenses from matrix_long/the scg graph, NOT from any measured OCSF binding. A measured class binding is never to be confused with an inferred D3FEND lead. Entries marked runnable=true have a Sigma rule + a Store F column set + a ground-truth needle, so they can be scored DETECTED/MISSED/NOISY today. Entries marked runnable=false are console-only (no rule or no planted needle) and surface as MISSED-by-construction gaps, never silent drops.
